Spec vs implementation mismatches:
- apply_discount: rounding & error handling likely ok.
- bulk_discount_percent returns wrong values (currently 0 or 5 instead of expected percentages).
- parse_coupon returns int not dict; rejects valid coupon codes.
- shipping_fee calculation wrong (returns 60,30 instead of expected).
- Cart.items returns {'name':qty} dict instead of list of item dicts.
- Cart.total expects coupon string but receives parsed dict.
- In total: uses apply_discount incorrectly with dict.
